changes.result: Опубликован source composition commit 4cc4cd85f4c8d55873d3f054ce5fdd6288c127f1 на origin/main. Owned paths only: src/ahap-zcode-runner.ts, tests/ahap-zcode-runner.test.ts, acceptance/native/zcode/ahap-contract.json. Проверки на чистой базе после npm ci и npm run build:core: `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --root . --config vitest.config.ts tests/ahap-zcode-runner.test.ts` — 4/4 passed; `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --pretty false` — exit 0; `git diff --cached --check` — passed. Manifest argv: ["$AHAP_ZCODE_SERVER_NODE", "$AHAP_ZCODE_SERVER_ENTRY"], cwd=$AHAP_ZCODE_CWD; required env AHAP_VERSION=0.1, AHAP_HARNESS=zcode and the three absolute AHAP_ZCODE_* paths. Reuses existing ZcodeAdapter/native driver; ambiguous mutation UNKNOWN, no retry. Native case NOT RUN, remains V078; V072D/E UNKNOWN were not replayed. Foreign WIP in shared Luna checkout and other ZCode worktrees preserved.
